schemes.Track-Bearer-Auth.description: "A private key (`sk_`) or public key (`pk_`), used as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. To route Track API data to destinations outside Customer.io, associate your public or private key with an integration source. Customer.io uses the integration source to determine where to send traffic from the key. If your workspace is configured to route Track API data to destinations outside Customer.io, the Track API rejects requests made with a key that has no integration source (`403 Forbidden`). Create keys on the [API Credentials page](https://fly.customer.io/settings/api_credentials).

Use a private key on your server. Use a public key in a browser or mobile app.
"

schemes.Tracking-API-Key.description: "Legacy Track credentials: your **Site ID** and **Track API key**, **Base-64 encoded** in the format `site_id:api_key`. For new integrations, use a private or public key as a bearer token instead.

You can find your Site ID and Track API key on the [API Credentials page](https://fly.customer.io/settings/api_credentials).
"
